providers.title: Radio providers
providers.desc: Connect radio providers the same way as streaming services. TuneIn surfaces your presets; Radio Paradise adds curated, listener-supported streams.

radioParadise.desc: Curated, high-quality radio streams. Available in the Loxone app under radio sources.

library.title: Library
library.desc: Loxone supports local and network libraries — we emulate the same experience. Drop files under <1>data/music/local</1>, upload audio here, or add network shares.

local.title: Local library
local.desc: Files stored on the AudioServer itself.

drop.title: Drop audio here
drop.sub: or click to select a file

share.scanPromptSub: Mounted successfully — run a scan to index the audio files on this share.

form.cifsHelp: Passed verbatim to mount.cifs. Leave the defaults unless your NAS needs specific flags.

feedback.removeShareMessage: This will remove the network share from the AudioServer library configuration.
feedback.rescanStarted: Library rescan started. New tracks will appear shortly.

feedback.uploaded_other: Uploaded {{count}} files{{suffix}}. Library rescan started; new tracks will appear shortly.

linein.title: Line-in

modal.iconHelp: Pick the icon to show next to the source.

modal.bridgeHelp: Bind a registered bridge and choose its capture device.
modal.selectBridgeFirst: Select a bridge to view capture devices

modal.vadHelp: Control when streaming starts and stops on silence.

modal.captureHelp: Optional controls for when Sendspin starts/stops streaming on silence.
modal.manualCopy: Manual ingest supports WebSocket and TCP per line-in.

spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.desc: Multi-account Spotify is supported out of the box. Set the Client ID once, then link as many accounts as you like — here or in the Loxone app.

summary.setFirst: Set a Client ID to begin

spotify.clientIdDesc: Create a Spotify app, then paste the Client ID below — no client secret needed. Create one at <1>developer.spotify.com/dashboard/create</1> using these details.
spotify.accountsDesc: Link one or more Spotify accounts to expose them as sources in Loxone. Add as many as you need.
spotify.noAccountsSub: Add one to enable Spotify sources in Loxone.
spotify.accountsNote: Spotify login may be blocked by popup blockers; allow popups to complete linking.

cache.title: Track cache
cache.desc: Cache decoded tracks on disk. Repeat plays skip the CDN download and avoid decode errors from partial transfers.

feedback.loginFlow: Follow the Spotify login flow to complete account linking.

custom.title: Streaming services
custom.desc: Add your streaming accounts — Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube Music, or Music Assistant. They're available to the media server (DLNA), Subsonic and the player. When the Loxone role is enabled, each is also exposed as a Spotify-compatible source so the Loxone app can list it.
custom.activeDesc: When the Loxone role is on, each service also appears as its own Spotify-compatible source in the Loxone app.
custom.emptySub: Add a service to make Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube Music or Music Assistant available.

bridge.subtitle: Add a streaming account and choose how to connect it
bridge.providerDesc: Pick which streaming service you want to add.
bridge.nameHelp: Shown in the Loxone app. Give each account a distinct name to tell multiple logins of the same service apart.

ma.desc: Music Assistant exposes one Spotify account per configured MA account. Create dedicated MA accounts with provider filters to surface specific services in Loxone.
ma.connectionDesc: Tell the bridge where to reach your Music Assistant server.
ma.apiKeyHelp: Generate a long-lived token under your Music Assistant account settings.
ma.modeDesc: Choose how Music Assistant integrates with this audio server. You can change this at any time.
ma.sourceDesc: Music Assistant streams audio into this audio server. Each Loxone zone gets a virtual MA player and audio plays through the zone's normal output (sendspin, etc.).
sourceBullets: Audio flows through this server's outputs
Other sources (Spotify Connect, line-in, alerts) keep working alongside MA
Best when MA is your music library / streaming brain and Loxone owns the speakers
ma.sinkDesc: Existing Music Assistant players (Sonos, Chromecast, snapcast, …) appear as Loxone zone outputs. This server only proxies commands and mirrors state.
sinkBullets: No audio passes through this server
Loxone shows live status from MA (now-playing, volume, queue)
Best when MA is already your primary music server

apple.desc: Use a Media User Token from music.apple.com to enable Apple Music browsing and playback. Tokens can be refreshed anytime from your browser session.
apple.tokenDesc: Sign in with Apple to fetch your token automatically, or paste one from your music.apple.com session.
apple.signInHint: Opens an Apple sign-in window and fills the token in for you.
apple.signInPopupBlocked: Could not open the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
apple.widevineDesc: Required for Apple Music DRM playback. Stored locally under <1>data/widevine_cdm</1>.
apple.uploadHint: Select private_key.pem and/or client_id.bin before uploading.

ytmusic.desc: YouTube Music uses browser cookies for authentication. Paste a full Cookie header from your signed-in music.youtube.com session to enable your library and liked songs.
ytmusic.title: Cookie header
ytmusic.descLong: From <1>music.youtube.com</1> DevTools: Network request → Request Headers → <3>cookie: …</3> (paste the value only).

youtube.desc: YouTube works out of the box with no credentials — search and public playlists are available immediately. Add an API key for better search quality.
youtube.callout1: Streams take a few seconds to start.
youtube.callout1Text: YouTube does not expose direct audio URLs — each track is resolved on demand via yt-dlp, which typically takes 3–7 seconds on a cold cache.
youtube.callout2End: immediately, then switches to the track name once audio begins. Subsequent plays are served from a 1-hour cache.
youtube.apiDesc: Enables better search results and trending music charts. Without it, search still works via yt-dlp. Get a free key at <1>Google Cloud Console</1> → Enable "YouTube Data API v3" → Create API key.

deezer.desc: Deezer works without credentials for public catalog data. Add an ARL cookie only if you need private playlists or recommendations.
deezer.title: ARL cookie
deezer.descLong: Add your Deezer ARL cookie to access private playlists or recommendations.

soundcloud.desc: Stream tracks, sets and likes from SoundCloud.
soundcloud.title: OAuth Token (required)
soundcloud.descLong: SoundCloud requires an OAuth token from a logged-in account. Open soundcloud.com in your browser, sign in, then copy the value after 'OAuth ' from the Authorization header of any api-v2 request (DevTools → Network). Note: a minority of tracks are DRM-protected and cannot be played.

tidal.desc: Provide a valid access token plus a two-letter country code to enable Tidal catalog and playback.
tidal.title: Access token
tidal.descLong: Paste a token from your device authorization flow.

hero.tagline: A full-featured multiroom audio server — streaming, AirPlay and DLNA in every room.

login.title: Welcome back.

welcome.title: Your audio server is ready
welcome.introStep1: Let's get it set up — it only takes a minute.
welcome.introStep2: This is the login you'll use to reach the control panel from now on.

pairing.title: Awaiting Miniserver config
pairing.subtitle: Waiting for the Miniserver to push an audio configuration.
pairing.statusSub: The AudioServer is online. Pairing will continue as soon as the Miniserver deploys the project.
pairing.step2: Split your stereo outputs to get all 4 outputs. Drag the outputs into your project. This creates a corresponding player block and results in 4 audio zones. Add stereo extensions later if you need more.
pairing.step3: Deploy changes and reboot the Miniserver to start pairing.

reset.title: Resetting server
reset.subtitle: Wiping the configuration and restarting with a clean slate.
reset.statusSub: This takes a few seconds. You'll land back on the welcome screen when it's done.

switch.subtitle: Restarting the server so the new setup takes effect.
switch.statusSub: This takes a few seconds. The right screen appears as soon as it's back.

server.title: Server
server.desc: Runs standalone — no Miniserver required. Zones, inputs and behaviour are managed here.
server.descLoxone: Paired with a Loxone Miniserver. Pairing, sync and access control live on the Loxone tab.
server.copyHint: Copy versions, runtime and identity as text for a bug report
server.copyFailedMessage: The browser blocked clipboard access — select the values manually.

pairing.title: Miniserver connection
pairing.descPaired: This server is paired with a Loxone Miniserver. The Miniserver pushes the audio configuration and controls playback state for connected zones.
pairing.descUnpaired: The server is online but not yet paired. Add it in Loxone Config and deploy the project to pair.
pairing.pairHint: Add this server in Loxone Config as an Audioserver, then deploy the project. Pairing completes automatically.

crossfade.rowDesc: Applied to all zones when one track ends and the next begins.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.desc: Require a login for the admin interface and the player. Credentials are checked against the Miniserver, so this only applies once paired.
auth.rowDesc: When enabled, users must sign in before reaching the admin tabs or the player UI.

groups.rowDesc: Let zones with different output protocols share a group. They play together, but without sample-accurate sync.
groups.note: A group still prefers protocol-based sync wherever it can — mixed groups only kick in when members cannot match.

tts.desc: Engine used for spoken alerts and announcements. Currently configured: <1>{{provider}}</1>.
tts.providerInternalDesc: Built-in Google TTS. No external services required.

tts.mqttHostDesc: Hostname or IP of the LoxBerry MQTT broker.
tts.validation: Provide a host and a valid port (1–65535).

events.descPrefix: Upload custom MP3 files for the

playback.desc: Applies to every zone on this server.

maintenance.title: Server maintenance
maintenance.desc: Restart the service, keep a backup of the configuration, or start over.

sync.desc: What the Miniserver last pushed to this server.

zones.title: Players
zones.subtitle: A player is a single device you play music on. Group several to play in sync, and let phones and apps cast to one over AirPlay, Spotify Connect or DLNA — even devices that don't support those themselves.

setup.title: How are players set up?
setup.desc: Pick one. You can change it later.

none.label: Disabled
none.desc: No players. This server only shares your music with other apps through Access.

manual.label: Set up here
manual.desc: You add players yourself — speakers and rooms you name, group and cast to.

loxone.label: Loxone integrated
loxone.desc: Your Miniserver pushes which players exist and their names — you still set each one's output and receivers here.

setup.confirmManualMessage: This disconnects the Loxone integration. The Miniserver stops supplying players and you manage them here.
setup.confirmOffMessage: This disconnects the Loxone integration and leaves the server sharing content only.

loxone.descWaiting: Connected — waiting for the Miniserver to push its players.
loxone.descPaired: Connected — players come from your Miniserver. Set each one's output and receivers here.
loxone.modalConnectSub: Pair this server with a Loxone Miniserver. It starts listening right away and waits for the Miniserver to push its players. Any players you set up here are set aside while Loxone is connected.
loxone.modalWaitingSub: Connected. Waiting for the Miniserver to push its configuration — follow the steps below in Loxone Config.
loxone.modalPairedSub: Connected. Your Miniserver supplies the players and their names; you configure each one's output and receivers here. Disconnect to manage players locally instead.

loxone.step3: Deploy the changes and reboot the Miniserver to start pairing.

zones.emptySub: Pair the AudioServer with a Miniserver and assign zones in Loxone Config to populate this view.

eqTitle.warn: EQ forwarder selected but no callback URL set

modal.resetVolumeCopy: Restore the configured default volume immediately when the zone is paused (matches the reference Loxone Audio Server).
modal.stateControllerDesc: Select where zone playback state is controlled.

eq.builtinDetail: Bakes the 10-band EQ into the ffmpeg pipeline on this audioserver, applied after resampling. Bands map onto ISO frequencies (31 Hz — 16 kHz) at Q 1. Slider changes restart the encoder, so expect a brief gap (<1 s) in audio while you adjust. Sync-group members follow the leader's EQ.
eq.squeezeliteIntro: Forwarder for the LoxBerry <1>Squeezelite Multi-Room</1> plugin. On every App-driven EQ write the audioserver POSTs <3>{ zoneId, bands }</3> to the plugin endpoint, which applies the 10-band values to the matching zone's alsaequal chain.
eq.callbackHelp: Point this at your LoxBerry host. Leave blank to keep the provider selected without forwarding — the chip on the tile turns amber to signal a missing URL.

output.noTransports: No transports available for this build.
output.selectDevice: Select a device to route audio.
output.noCast: No Google Cast devices found yet.

access.title: How your content is shared
access.subtitle: Serve the content you set up to other apps and devices on your network — all through one server. Turn on the ways you want; each works on its own.

servers.failedMessage: Failed to update the server settings
servers.subsonicNoCredentials: Create a user under Users first — this server has no Miniserver to authenticate against.

dlna.name: DLNA / UPnP
dlna.purpose: A media server on your network: any DLNA device — smart TV, receiver, speaker — browses and plays everything this server offers. Streaming services included, so Spotify or Apple Music reach gear that has no app for them.

subsonic.name: Subsonic API
subsonic.purpose: A widely supported music API. Point an app like Symfonium, Amperfy or DSub at the address below and sign in with your account to browse and stream everything this server offers.

loxone.name: Loxone Audio Server
loxone.purpose: A complete Loxone Audioserver implementation: it integrates fully into your Loxone setup and behaves like the real thing.
loxone.hint: Switch this on under Players, by choosing Loxone integrated.
